title: 2026 Seoul Mayoral Election Winner
description:
The 2026 Seoul mayoral election is scheduled to take place on June 3, 2026 to elect the next mayor of Seoul.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate that wins this election.

If the result of this election isn't known by January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the South Korean government, specifically the National Election Commission.

eventMetadata.context_description: Democratic Party candidate Chong Won-oh commands overwhelming trader consensus at 87.5% implied probability for the June 3, 2026 Seoul mayoral election, driven by recent polls showing him ahead of incumbent People Power Party Mayor Oh Se-hoon by double digits—such as 49.7% to 35.9% in a late April survey. Chong secured the ruling party's nomination on April 9 after winning the primary with over 50% support, leveraging his successful three-term record as Seongdong-gu district chief amid voter frustration over housing policies and national approval ratings favoring the Democratic Party. Oh Se-hoon clinched his party's nod on April 18 but trails in head-to-head matchups, with conservative voter consolidation and real estate sentiment as key variables ahead of the local elections vote. Late developments like campaign pledges or scandals could shift dynamics.
